label: Copy phase, last two outputs; strongest for short sequences or certain fed-back tokens (f,h,b,3,...)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L). It is never active in the original phase, at the delimiter, or at recall_idx 0, and almost never when to_go >= 6. About 79% of activation mass falls on the last two outputs (to_go <= 1). Firing is strongly modulated by the fed-back input token: f, h, b and 3 have the highest rates (f and h at roughly 4x lift), then z, e, g and 0. Short sequences (L=3 and L=4) fire at much higher rates. The top activations are all L=3 sequences at the final step (recall_idx 2) whose input is f, b or z. Earlier copy steps (to_go 2 to 5) fire weakly, and mostly on the same preferred tokens. Precision is limited: many late copy steps with non-preferred tokens and longer L stay inactive. It does not fire on first occurrences of a token (in_first=1).
